51609584.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to PRMT4 (140 to 480 residues) (unknown origin) assessed as dissociation constant by ITC method

original_paragraph.ITC Measurements: Isothermal Titration Calorimetry. ITC measurements were performed at 25 °C by using a MicroCal PEAQ-ITC calorimeter. For titrations, purified PRMT4 (140–480) was diluted with 1× buffer (pH 8.0, 25 mM Tris 8.0, 100 mM NaCl) to a final concentration of 4 μM, and YD1130 was dissolved to 100 μM in the same buffer. YD1130 was titrated into the protein solution with 18 injections of 2 μL each. Injections were spaced 150 s with a reference power of 10 μcal/s. The titration curves were fitted to obtain the association constant (1/Ka), enthalpy of binding (ΔH), and stoichiometry of binding (N) using MicroCal PEAQ-ITC analysis software. All data were fitted by using the one-site binding model.
original_paragraph.Figure 9c caption: Representative ITC data of YD1130 bound to PRMT4 (140–480 aa). The experiment was performed in duplicate (n = 2).
